title: Energy ETFs are the unloved relative to ‘outstanding’ gains as growth bets in stock market head for worst first half ever
description: In this week’s ETF Wrap, I spoke with Todd Sohn of Strategas about this year's lagging inflows into energy, the sole sector of the S&P 500 that’s seen gains in 2022.
